task.title: Replace the Settings page with the new system UI design
task.objective: Apply the attached SpecterStudio system UI language to the Settings page only, preserving every existing Settings control, permission gate, validation rule, and persistence action.

architecture: Change the Settings renderer only; preserve the app shell, route, preload API, settings schema, and main-process persistence.
Reuse the existing Hologram tokens, controls, settings subcomponents, and page-chrome action system.
Do not copy demo values or simulated behavior from the attached design artifact.
accessibility: Keep semantic headings, visible focus styles, keyboard-operable actions, responsive layout, and reduced-motion behavior.
offline: Do not add remote assets, fonts, scripts, dependencies, or runtime network access.

acceptance.description: Settings uses the attached system design language: page-header Save action, icon-led section introductions, responsive panel grids, and compact token-driven cards, without changing other routes or the app-shell grid.
Every existing Settings control, permission gate, confirmation, validation message, immediate-save path, and persisted Save action remains wired to its existing handler.
The task records accurate AI-memory and roadmap evidence before terminal closeout.
